text:
leah: flagging prod canaries in us-west-2 failing immediately after deploy — multiple 500s, looks like KMS decryption errors in the stack traces. paging oncall.
incident-bot: :rotating_light: New incident created: prod-deploy-kms-accessdenied — severity: P1? PagerDuty alerted (eng-oncall)
devon: acked. jumping in. which release and which key did deploy reference?
deploy-bot: Deploy by koji: release/config-operator-20260315 @ 2026-03-15T14:05. Changed env: REDWOOD_KMS_KEY=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/rotated-key-2026b
maria: I rotated that key at 14:00 as part of scheduled rotation and attached alias. I thought we had added the service role to key grants — will verify immediately.
leah: snippets from the canary logs:
```
14:07:35 service-config ERROR KMS Decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789:assumed-role/service-role is not authorized to use key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/rotated-key-2026b
14:07:35 service-config WARN request-id=xyz-789 failed decrypt
```
koji: we have a canary kill switch via feature-flag `route:config-v2` — recommend flipping it to route traffic back to stable immediately while we root cause.
maria: I'll confirm key policy in parallel. @koji can you flip the flag?
koji: running: `ffctl set --env=prod --flag route:config-v2 --value=false --who=koji` — done. Response: OK.
leah: after flag flip, canary error rate dropped to baseline within 90s. Good mitigation. We still saw ~6 failed requests from premium customers during the 3-minute window.
customer-success: CS update: 3 customers reported failures, 1 (Beta Labs) reported inference timeouts. Not widespread but high-touch customer impacted.
devon: We need to avoid reintroducing that config. Let's roll back the release and then fix key policy in a staging/test account first.
koji: initiating rollback: `deployctl rollback --release config-operator-20260315 --reason "kms key perms mismatch"`
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated for config-operator-20260315 — status: in_progress
maria: I'm drafting the key policy change. Proposed command after rollback: `aws kms put-key-policy --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/rotated-key-2026b --policy file://allow-service-decrypt.json`
devon: Important: do NOT re-deploy the release until we confirm policy change in staging and run the new predeploy smoke check that verifies KMS decrypt for service principal.
koji: rollback finished. traffic back to release/config-operator-20260314. Canary and prod health checks passing. deploy-bot: rollback complete :white_check_mark:
leah: verifying logs — no further KMS AccessDenied after rollback. Canaries green.
maria: I'll run the key-policy update in a staging key and then run an automated smoke test that invokes KMS decrypt with the service role.
devon: handoff: Maria will own post-incident action items and customer comms. I'll tag postmortem and action items.
maria: acked. I'll open INC-20260315-43 for the incident, include timeline, root cause (missing decrypt grant on rotated key), and action items: 1) add KMS permission verification into rotation runbook; 2) extend pre-deploy smoke tests to include KMS decrypt step; 3) add explicit gate before feature flag release when key rotations happen same day. Will notify CS to reach out to impacted customers.
incident-bot: Incident resolved: prod-deploy-kms-accessdenied. Severity: Sev2. Duration: ~12 minutes. Incident ticket: INC-20260315-43
leah: thanks everyone for the quick mitigation. I'll pull detailed traces and link them to the postmortem. Reminder: runbook used: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kms-rotation and deploy checklist: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/deploy-canary
maria: will coordinate a staged re-rollout once key policy validation and staging tests pass.
__notes: generated by dataset generator: deploy-related canary failures due to rotated KMS key missing decrypt permissions; feature-flag kill-switch + rollback + post-incident actions
